# Cyber Kings (2026-11-13): formable hegemonies. GENERATED by _dev/scripts/hegemonies/gen_hegemonies.py - change the generator, not this file.
# "Unite" casus belli of the formable hegemonies, one per target tier. Modelled on vanilla imperial_reconquest_cb
# (00_dejure_war.txt): the attacker takes the defender's de jure share of the target (code effect setup_de_jure_cb).
# Targets: titles on the hegemony's worlds that are NOT already de jure part of it. Terra has no hegemony-tier version.
# After a victory, empires now at least half inside the attacker's realm become de jure part of the hegemony.

ck_unite_terra_county_cb = {
	icon = individual_county_de_jure_cb
	group = de_jure
	combine_into_one = yes
	should_show_war_goal_subview = yes
	mutually_exclusive_titles = { always = yes }

	allowed_for_character = {
		scope:attacker = { has_title = title:h_ck_terra }
	}
	allowed_against_character = {
		NOR = {
			scope:defender = { target_is_liege_or_above = scope:attacker }
			scope:attacker = { target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender }
			scope:defender = scope:attacker
		}
	}
	target_titles = all
	target_title_tier = all
	target_de_jure_regions_above = yes
	ignore_effect = change_title_holder
	ai_only_against_neighbors = yes
	max_ai_diplo_distance_to_title = 500

	valid_to_start = {
		scope:target = {
			tier = tier_county
			title_province = { geographical_region = ckworld_earth }
			NOT = { any_this_title_or_de_jure_above = { this = title:h_ck_terra } }
			holder ?= {
					OR = {
						this = scope:defender
						target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender
					}
				}
		}
	}

	cost = {
		piety = {
			value = 0
			add = common_cb_impious_piety_cost
		}
		prestige = {
			value = 0
			add = {
				add = ck_unite_cb_prestige_per_county
				desc = CB_CLAIM_COST_TARGET_TITLES
			}
			max = ck_unite_cb_prestige_max
			multiply = common_cb_prestige_cost_multiplier
		}
	}

	on_declaration = { on_declared_war = yes }

	should_invalidate = {
		NOT = {
			any_in_list = {
				list = target_titles
				holder ?= {
					OR = {
						this = scope:defender
						target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	on_invalidated_desc = msg_invalidate_war_title
	on_invalidated = { }

	on_victory_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:attacker = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_victory_desc_attacker
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_victory_desc
		}
	}
	on_victory = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		add_legitimacy_attacker_victory_effect = yes
		create_title_and_vassal_change = {
			type = conquest
			save_scope_as = change
			add_claim_on_loss = yes
		}
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			change = scope:change
			title = scope:target
		}
		resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:change
		custom_tooltip = ck_unite_cb_absorb_tt
		hidden_effect = { scope:attacker = { ck_hegemony_absorb_realm_effect = { HEG = h_ck_terra BLOC = ckworld_earth FOUNDER = scope:attacker } } }
		add_truce_attacker_victory_effect = yes
	}

	on_white_peace_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:defender = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_white_peace_desc_defender
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_white_peace_desc
		}
	}
	on_white_peace = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			victory = no
			title = scope:target
		}
		add_truce_white_peace_effect = yes
	}

	on_defeat_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:defender = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc_defender
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:attacker = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc_attacker
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc
		}
	}
	on_defeat = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		add_legitimacy_attacker_defeat_effect = yes
		scope:attacker = {
			pay_short_term_gold_reparations_effect = { GOLD_VALUE = 10 }
		}
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			victory = no
			title = scope:target
		}
		add_truce_attacker_defeat_effect = yes
	}

	on_primary_attacker_death = inherit
	on_primary_defender_death = inherit
	transfer_behavior = transfer
	attacker_allies_inherit = yes
	defender_allies_inherit = yes

	war_name = "CK_UNITE_TERRA_COUNTY_CB_WAR_NAME"
	war_name_base = "CK_UNITE_TERRA_COUNTY_CB_WAR_NAME_BASE"
	cb_name = "CK_UNITE_TERRA_COUNTY_CB_NAME"
	interface_priority = 97
	attacker_wargoal_percentage = 0.8
	max_defender_score_from_occupation = 150
	max_attacker_score_from_occupation = 150

	ai_score_mult = { value = 1 }
}

ck_unite_terra_duchy_cb = {
	icon = individual_duchy_de_jure_cb
	group = de_jure
	combine_into_one = yes
	should_show_war_goal_subview = yes
	mutually_exclusive_titles = { always = yes }

	allowed_for_character = {
		scope:attacker = { has_title = title:h_ck_terra }

	allowed_against_character = {

	target_titles = all

	target_de_jure_regions_above = yes
	ignore_effect = change_title_holder
	ai_only_against_neighbors = yes
	max_ai_diplo_distance_to_title = 500

	valid_to_start = {
		scope:target = {
			tier = tier_duchy
			title_capital_county ?= { title_province = { geographical_region = ckworld_earth } }
			NOT = { any_this_title_or_de_jure_above = { this = title:h_ck_terra } }
			any_in_de_jure_hierarchy = {
				tier = tier_county
				holder ?= {
					OR = {
						this = scope:defender
						target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	cost = {
		piety = {
			value = 0
			add = common_cb_impious_piety_cost
		}
		prestige = {
			value = 0
			add = {
				every_in_list = {
					list = target_titles
					every_in_de_jure_hierarchy = {
						limit = {
							tier = tier_county
							OR = {
								holder.top_liege = scope:defender
								holder.liege = scope:defender
								holder.liege = scope:defender.liege
							}
						}
						add = ck_unite_cb_prestige_per_county
					}
				}
				desc = CB_CLAIM_COST_TARGET_TITLES
			}
			max = ck_unite_cb_prestige_max
			multiply = common_cb_prestige_cost_multiplier
		}

	on_declaration = { on_declared_war = yes }

	should_invalidate = {
		NOT = {

					tier = tier_county
					holder ?= {
						OR = {
							this = scope:defender
							target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender

					}

			}
		}

	on_invalidated = { }

		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:attacker = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_victory_desc_attacker
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_victory_desc
		}
	}

		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			victory = no
			title = scope:target
		}
		add_truce_white_peace_effect = yes
	}

	on_defeat_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:defender = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc_defender
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:attacker = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc_attacker
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc
		}
	}
	on_defeat = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		add_legitimacy_attacker_defeat_effect = yes
		scope:attacker = {
			pay_short_term_gold_reparations_effect = { GOLD_VALUE = 10 }
		}
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			victory = no
			title = scope:target
		}
		add_truce_attacker_defeat_effect = yes
	}

	on_primary_attacker_death = inherit
	on_primary_defender_death = inherit
	transfer_behavior = transfer
	attacker_allies_inherit = yes
	defender_allies_inherit = yes

	war_name = "CK_UNITE_TERRA_EMPIRE_CB_WAR_NAME"
	war_name_base = "CK_UNITE_TERRA_EMPIRE_CB_WAR_NAME_BASE"
	cb_name = "CK_UNITE_TERRA_EMPIRE_CB_NAME"
	interface_priority = 97
	attacker_wargoal_percentage = 0.8
	max_defender_score_from_occupation = 150
	max_attacker_score_from_occupation = 150

	ai_score_mult = { value = 1 }
}

ck_unite_helian_county_cb = {
	icon = individual_county_de_jure_cb
	group = de_jure
	combine_into_one = yes
	should_show_war_goal_subview = yes
	mutually_exclusive_titles = { always = yes }

	allowed_for_character = {
		scope:attacker = { has_title = title:h_ck_helian }
	}
	allowed_against_character = {
		NOR = {
			scope:defender = { target_is_liege_or_above = scope:attacker }
			scope:attacker = { target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender }
			scope:defender = scope:attacker
		}
	}
	target_titles = all
	target_title_tier = all
	target_de_jure_regions_above = yes
	ignore_effect = change_title_holder
	ai_only_against_neighbors = no

	valid_to_start = {
		scope:target = {
			tier = tier_county
			title_province = { geographical_region = ckbloc_helian }
			NOT = { any_this_title_or_de_jure_above = { this = title:h_ck_helian } }
			holder ?= {
					OR = {
						this = scope:defender
						target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender
					}
				}
		}
	}

	cost = {
		piety = {
			value = 0
			add = common_cb_impious_piety_cost
		}
		prestige = {
			value = 0
			add = {
				add = ck_unite_cb_prestige_per_county
				desc = CB_CLAIM_COST_TARGET_TITLES
			}
			max = ck_unite_cb_prestige_max
			multiply = common_cb_prestige_cost_multiplier
		}
	}

	on_declaration = { on_declared_war = yes }

	should_invalidate = {
		NOT = {
			any_in_list = {
				list = target_titles
				holder ?= {
					OR = {
						this = scope:defender
						target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	on_invalidated_desc = msg_invalidate_war_title
	on_invalidated = { }

	on_victory_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:attacker = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_victory_desc_attacker
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_victory_desc
		}
	}
	on_victory = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		add_legitimacy_attacker_victory_effect = yes
		create_title_and_vassal_change = {
			type = conquest
			save_scope_as = change
			add_claim_on_loss = yes
		}
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			change = scope:change
			title = scope:target
		}
		resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:change
		custom_tooltip = ck_unite_cb_absorb_tt
		hidden_effect = { scope:attacker = { ck_hegemony_absorb_realm_effect = { HEG = h_ck_helian BLOC = ckbloc_helian FOUNDER = scope:attacker } } }
		add_truce_attacker_victory_effect = yes
	}

	on_white_peace_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:defender = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_white_peace_desc_defender
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_white_peace_desc
		}
	}
	on_white_peace = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			victory = no
			title = scope:target
		}
		add_truce_white_peace_effect = yes
	}

	on_defeat_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:defender = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc_defender
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:attacker = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc_attacker
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc
		}
	}
	on_defeat = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		add_legitimacy_attacker_defeat_effect = yes
		scope:attacker = {
			pay_short_term_gold_reparations_effect = { GOLD_VALUE = 10 }
		}
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			victory = no
			title = scope:target
		}
		add_truce_attacker_defeat_effect = yes
	}

	on_primary_attacker_death = inherit
	on_primary_defender_death = inherit
	transfer_behavior = transfer
	attacker_allies_inherit = yes
	defender_allies_inherit = yes

	war_name = "CK_UNITE_HELIAN_COUNTY_CB_WAR_NAME"
	war_name_base = "CK_UNITE_HELIAN_COUNTY_CB_WAR_NAME_BASE"
	cb_name = "CK_UNITE_HELIAN_COUNTY_CB_NAME"
	interface_priority = 97
	attacker_wargoal_percentage = 0.8
	max_defender_score_from_occupation = 150
	max_attacker_score_from_occupation = 150

	ai_score_mult = { value = 1 }
}

ck_unite_helian_duchy_cb = {
	icon = individual_duchy_de_jure_cb
	group = de_jure
	combine_into_one = yes
	should_show_war_goal_subview = yes
	mutually_exclusive_titles = { always = yes }

	allowed_for_character = {
		scope:attacker = { has_title = title:h_ck_helian }
	}
	allowed_against_character = {
		NOR = {
			scope:defender = { target_is_liege_or_above = scope:attacker }
			scope:attacker = { target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender }
			scope:defender = scope:attacker
		}
	}
	target_titles = all
	target_title_tier = all
	target_de_jure_regions_above = yes
	ignore_effect = change_title_holder
	ai_only_against_neighbors = no

	valid_to_start = {
		scope:target = {
			tier = tier_duchy
			title_capital_county ?= { title_province = { geographical_region = ckbloc_helian } }
			NOT = { any_this_title_or_de_jure_above = { this = title:h_ck_helian } }
			any_in_de_jure_hierarchy = {
				tier = tier_county
				holder ?= {
					OR = {
						this = scope:defender
						target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	cost = {
		piety = {
			value = 0
			add = common_cb_impious_piety_cost
		}
		prestige = {
			value = 0
			add = {
				every_in_list = {
					list = target_titles
					every_in_de_jure_hierarchy = {
						limit = {
							tier = tier_county
							OR = {
								holder.top_liege = scope:defender
								holder.liege = scope:defender
								holder.liege = scope:defender.liege
							}
						}
						add = ck_unite_cb_prestige_per_county
					}
				}
				desc = CB_CLAIM_COST_TARGET_TITLES
			}
			max = ck_unite_cb_prestige_max
			multiply = common_cb_prestige_cost_multiplier
		}
	}

	on_declaration = { on_declared_war = yes }

	should_invalidate = {
		NOT = {
			any_in_list = {
				list = target_titles
				any_in_de_jure_hierarchy = {
					tier = tier_county
					holder ?= {
						OR = {
							this = scope:defender
							target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	on_invalidated_desc = msg_invalidate_war_title
	on_invalidated = { }

	on_victory_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:attacker = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_victory_desc_attacker
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_victory_desc
		}
	}
	on_victory = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		add_legitimacy_attacker_victory_effect = yes
		create_title_and_vassal_change = {
			type = conquest
			save_scope_as = change
			add_claim_on_loss = yes
		}
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			change = scope:change
			title = scope:target
		}
		resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:change
		custom_tooltip = ck_unite_cb_absorb_tt
		hidden_effect = { scope:attacker = { ck_hegemony_absorb_realm_effect = { HEG = h_ck_helian BLOC = ckbloc_helian FOUNDER = scope:attacker } } }
		add_truce_attacker_victory_effect = yes

	on_white_peace_desc = {

		}
		add_truce_white_peace_effect = yes
	}

	on_defeat_desc = {

		create_title_and_vassal_change = {
			type = conquest
			save_scope_as = change
			add_claim_on_loss = yes
		}
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			change = scope:change
			title = scope:target
		}
		resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:change
		custom_tooltip = ck_unite_cb_absorb_tt
		hidden_effect = { scope:attacker = { ck_hegemony_absorb_realm_effect = { HEG = h_ck_helian BLOC = ckbloc_helian FOUNDER = scope:attacker } } }
		add_truce_attacker_victory_effect = yes
	}

	on_white_peace_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:defender = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_white_peace_desc_defender
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_white_peace_desc
		}
	}
	on_white_peace = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			victory = no
			title = scope:target
		}
		add_truce_white_peace_effect = yes
	}

	on_defeat_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:defender = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc_defender
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:attacker = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc_attacker
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc
		}
	}
	on_defeat = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		add_legitimacy_attacker_defeat_effect = yes
		scope:attacker = {
			pay_short_term_gold_reparations_effect = { GOLD_VALUE = 10 }
		}
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			victory = no
			title = scope:target
		}
		add_truce_attacker_defeat_effect = yes
	}

	on_primary_attacker_death = inherit
	on_primary_defender_death = inherit
	transfer_behavior = transfer
	attacker_allies_inherit = yes
	defender_allies_inherit = yes

	war_name = "CK_UNITE_HELIAN_EMPIRE_CB_WAR_NAME"
	war_name_base = "CK_UNITE_HELIAN_EMPIRE_CB_WAR_NAME_BASE"
	cb_name = "CK_UNITE_HELIAN_EMPIRE_CB_NAME"
	interface_priority = 97
	attacker_wargoal_percentage = 0.8
	max_defender_score_from_occupation = 150
	max_attacker_score_from_occupation = 150

	ai_score_mult = { value = 1 }
}

ck_unite_helian_hegemony_cb = {
	icon = invasion_cb
	group = de_jure
	combine_into_one = yes
	should_show_war_goal_subview = yes
	mutually_exclusive_titles = { always = yes }

	allowed_for_character = {
		scope:attacker = { has_title = title:h_ck_helian }
	}
	allowed_against_character = {
		NOR = {
			scope:defender = { target_is_liege_or_above = scope:attacker }
			scope:attacker = { target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender }
			scope:defender = scope:attacker
		}
	}
	target_titles = all
	target_title_tier = all
	target_de_jure_regions_above = yes
	ignore_effect = change_title_holder
	ai_only_against_neighbors = no

	valid_to_start = {
		scope:target = {
			tier = tier_hegemony
			NOT = { this = title:h_ck_helian }
			title_capital_county ?= { title_province = { geographical_region = ckbloc_helian } }
			NOT = { any_this_title_or_de_jure_above = { this = title:h_ck_helian } }
			any_in_de_jure_hierarchy = {
				tier = tier_county
				holder ?= {
					OR = {
						this = scope:defender
						target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	cost = {
		piety = {
			value = 0
			add = common_cb_impious_piety_cost
		}
		prestige = {
			value = 0
			add = {
				every_in_list = {
					list = target_titles
					every_in_de_jure_hierarchy = {
						limit = {
							tier = tier_county
							OR = {
								holder.top_liege = scope:defender
								holder.liege = scope:defender
								holder.liege = scope:defender.liege
							}
						}
						add = ck_unite_cb_prestige_per_county
					}
				}
				desc = CB_CLAIM_COST_TARGET_TITLES
			}
			max = ck_unite_cb_prestige_max
			multiply = common_cb_prestige_cost_multiplier
		}
	}

	on_declaration = { on_declared_war = yes }

	should_invalidate = {
		NOT = {
			any_in_list = {
				list = target_titles
				any_in_de_jure_hierarchy = {
					tier = tier_county
					holder ?= {
						OR = {
							this = scope:defender
							target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	on_invalidated_desc = msg_invalidate_war_title
	on_invalidated = { }

	on_victory_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:attacker = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_victory_desc_attacker
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_victory_desc
		}
	}
	on_victory = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		add_legitimacy_attacker_victory_effect = yes
		create_title_and_vassal_change = {
			type = conquest
			save_scope_as = change
			add_claim_on_loss = yes
		}
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			change = scope:change
			title = scope:target
		}
		resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:change
		custom_tooltip = ck_unite_cb_absorb_tt
		hidden_effect = { scope:attacker = { ck_hegemony_absorb_realm_effect = { HEG = h_ck_helian BLOC = ckbloc_helian FOUNDER = scope:attacker } } }
		add_truce_attacker_victory_effect = yes
	}

	on_white_peace_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:defender = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_white_peace_desc_defender
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_white_peace_desc
		}
	}
	on_white_peace = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			victory = no
			title = scope:target
		}
		add_truce_white_peace_effect = yes
	}

	on_defeat_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:defender = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc_defender
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:attacker = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc_attacker
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc
		}
	}
	on_defeat = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		add_legitimacy_attacker_defeat_effect = yes
		scope:attacker = {
			pay_short_term_gold_reparations_effect = { GOLD_VALUE = 10 }
		}
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			victory = no
			title = scope:target
		}
		add_truce_attacker_defeat_effect = yes
	}

	on_primary_attacker_death = inherit
	on_primary_defender_death = inherit
	transfer_behavior = transfer
	attacker_allies_inherit = yes
	defender_allies_inherit = yes

	war_name = "CK_UNITE_HELIAN_HEGEMONY_CB_WAR_NAME"
	war_name_base = "CK_UNITE_HELIAN_HEGEMONY_CB_WAR_NAME_BASE"
	cb_name = "CK_UNITE_HELIAN_HEGEMONY_CB_NAME"
	interface_priority = 97
	attacker_wargoal_percentage = 0.8
	max_defender_score_from_occupation = 150
	max_attacker_score_from_occupation = 150

	ai_score_mult = { value = 1 }
}

							tier = tier_county
							OR = {
								holder.top_liege = scope:defender
								holder.liege = scope:defender
								holder.liege = scope:defender.liege
							}
						}
						add = ck_unite_cb_prestige_per_county
					}
				}
				desc = CB_CLAIM_COST_TARGET_TITLES
			}
			max = ck_unite_cb_prestige_max
			multiply = common_cb_prestige_cost_multiplier
		}
	}

	on_declaration = { on_declared_war = yes }

	should_invalidate = {
		NOT = {
			any_in_list = {
				list = target_titles
				any_in_de_jure_hierarchy = {
					tier = tier_county
					holder ?= {
						OR = {
							this = scope:defender
							target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	on_invalidated_desc = msg_invalidate_war_title
	on_invalidated = { }

	on_victory_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:attacker = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_victory_desc_attacker
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_victory_desc
		}
	}
	on_victory = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		add_legitimacy_attacker_victory_effect = yes
		create_title_and_vassal_change = {
			type = conquest
			save_scope_as = change
			add_claim_on_loss = yes
		}
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			change = scope:change
			title = scope:target
		}
		resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:change
		custom_tooltip = ck_unite_cb_absorb_tt
		hidden_effect = { scope:attacker = { ck_hegemony_absorb_realm_effect = { HEG = h_ck_celestial BLOC = ckbloc_celestial FOUNDER = scope:attacker } } }
		add_truce_attacker_victory_effect = yes
	}

	on_white_peace_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:defender = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_white_peace_desc_defender
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_white_peace_desc
		}
	}
	on_white_peace = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			victory = no
			title = scope:target
		}
		add_truce_white_peace_effect = yes
	}

	on_defeat_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:defender = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc_defender
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:attacker = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc_attacker
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc
		}
	}
	on_defeat = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		add_legitimacy_attacker_defeat_effect = yes
		scope:attacker = {
			pay_short_term_gold_reparations_effect = { GOLD_VALUE = 10 }
		}
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			victory = no
			title = scope:target
		}
		add_truce_attacker_defeat_effect = yes
	}

	on_primary_attacker_death = inherit
	on_primary_defender_death = inherit
	transfer_behavior = transfer
	attacker_allies_inherit = yes
	defender_allies_inherit = yes

	war_name = "CK_UNITE_CELESTIAL_KINGDOM_CB_WAR_NAME"
	war_name_base = "CK_UNITE_CELESTIAL_KINGDOM_CB_WAR_NAME_BASE"
	cb_name = "CK_UNITE_CELESTIAL_KINGDOM_CB_NAME"
	interface_priority = 97
	attacker_wargoal_percentage = 0.8
	max_defender_score_from_occupation = 150
	max_attacker_score_from_occupation = 150

	ai_score_mult = { value = 1 }
}

ck_unite_celestial_empire_cb = {
	icon = de_jure_cb
	group = de_jure
	combine_into_one = yes
	should_show_war_goal_subview = yes
	mutually_exclusive_titles = { always = yes }

	allowed_for_character = {
		scope:attacker = { has_title = title:h_ck_celestial }
	}
	allowed_against_character = {
		NOR = {
			scope:defender = { target_is_liege_or_above = scope:attacker }
			scope:attacker = { target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender }
			scope:defender = scope:attacker
		}
	}
	target_titles = all
	target_title_tier = all
	target_de_jure_regions_above = yes
	ignore_effect = change_title_holder
	ai_only_against_neighbors = no

	valid_to_start = {
		scope:target = {
			tier = tier_empire
			title_capital_county ?= { title_province = { geographical_region = ckbloc_celestial } }
			NOT = { any_this_title_or_de_jure_above = { this = title:h_ck_celestial } }
			any_in_de_jure_hierarchy = {
				tier = tier_county
				holder ?= {
					OR = {
						this = scope:defender
						target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	cost = {
		piety = {
			value = 0
			add = common_cb_impious_piety_cost
		}
		prestige = {
			value = 0
			add = {
				every_in_list = {
					list = target_titles
					every_in_de_jure_hierarchy = {
						limit = {
							tier = tier_county
							OR = {
								holder.top_liege = scope:defender
								holder.liege = scope:defender
								holder.liege = scope:defender.liege
							}
						}
						add = ck_unite_cb_prestige_per_county
					}
				}
				desc = CB_CLAIM_COST_TARGET_TITLES
			}
			max = ck_unite_cb_prestige_max
			multiply = common_cb_prestige_cost_multiplier
		}
	}

	on_declaration = { on_declared_war = yes }

	should_invalidate = {
		NOT = {
			any_in_list = {
				list = target_titles
				any_in_de_jure_hierarchy = {
					tier = tier_county
					holder ?= {
						OR = {
							this = scope:defender
							target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_invalidated = { }

	on_victory_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:attacker = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_victory_desc_attacker
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_victory_desc
		}
	}
	on_victory = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		add_legitimacy_attacker_victory_effect = yes
		create_title_and_vassal_change = {
			type = conquest
			save_scope_as = change
			add_claim_on_loss = yes
		}
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			change = scope:change
			title = scope:target
		}
		resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:change
		custom_tooltip = ck_unite_cb_absorb_tt
		hidden_effect = { scope:attacker = { ck_hegemony_absorb_realm_effect = { HEG = h_ck_celestial BLOC = ckbloc_celestial FOUNDER = scope:attacker } } }

		scope:attacker = { has_title = title:h_ck_sol }
	}
	allowed_against_character = {
		NOR = {
			scope:defender = { target_is_liege_or_above = scope:attacker }
			scope:attacker = { target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender }
			scope:defender = scope:attacker
		}
	}
	target_titles = all
	target_title_tier = all
	target_de_jure_regions_above = yes
	ignore_effect = change_title_holder
	ai_only_against_neighbors = no

	valid_to_start = {
		scope:target = {
			tier = tier_duchy
			title_capital_county ?= { title_province = { geographical_region = ckbloc_solar_system } }
			NOT = { any_this_title_or_de_jure_above = { this = title:h_ck_sol } }
			any_in_de_jure_hierarchy = {
				tier = tier_county
				holder ?= {
					OR = {
						this = scope:defender
						target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	cost = {
		piety = {
			value = 0
			add = common_cb_impious_piety_cost
		}
		prestige = {
			value = 0
			add = {
				every_in_list = {
					list = target_titles
					every_in_de_jure_hierarchy = {
						limit = {
							tier = tier_county
							OR = {
								holder.top_liege = scope:defender
								holder.liege = scope:defender
								holder.liege = scope:defender.liege
							}
						}
						add = ck_unite_cb_prestige_per_county
					}
				}
				desc = CB_CLAIM_COST_TARGET_TITLES
			}
			max = ck_unite_cb_prestige_max
			multiply = common_cb_prestige_cost_multiplier
		}
	}

	on_declaration = { on_declared_war = yes }

	should_invalidate = {
		NOT = {
			any_in_list = {
				list = target_titles
				any_in_de_jure_hierarchy = {
					tier = tier_county
					holder ?= {
						OR = {
							this = scope:defender
							target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	on_invalidated_desc = msg_invalidate_war_title
	on_invalidated = { }

	on_victory_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:attacker = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_victory_desc_attacker
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_victory_desc
		}
	}
	on_victory = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		add_legitimacy_attacker_victory_effect = yes
		create_title_and_vassal_change = {
			type = conquest
			save_scope_as = change
			add_claim_on_loss = yes
		}
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			change = scope:change
			title = scope:target
		}
		resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:change
		custom_tooltip = ck_unite_cb_absorb_tt
		hidden_effect = { scope:attacker = { ck_hegemony_absorb_realm_effect = { HEG = h_ck_sol BLOC = ckbloc_solar_system FOUNDER = scope:attacker } } }
		add_truce_attacker_victory_effect = yes
	}

	on_white_peace_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:defender = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_white_peace_desc_defender
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_white_peace_desc
		}
	}
	on_white_peace = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			victory = no
			title = scope:target
		}
		add_truce_white_peace_effect = yes
	}

	on_defeat_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:defender = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc_defender
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:attacker = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc_attacker
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc
		}
	}
	on_defeat = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		add_legitimacy_attacker_defeat_effect = yes
		scope:attacker = {
			pay_short_term_gold_reparations_effect = { GOLD_VALUE = 10 }
		}
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			victory = no
			title = scope:target
		}
		add_truce_attacker_defeat_effect = yes
	}

	on_primary_attacker_death = inherit
	on_primary_defender_death = inherit
	transfer_behavior = transfer
	attacker_allies_inherit = yes
	defender_allies_inherit = yes

	war_name = "CK_UNITE_SOL_DUCHY_CB_WAR_NAME"
	war_name_base = "CK_UNITE_SOL_DUCHY_CB_WAR_NAME_BASE"
	cb_name = "CK_UNITE_SOL_DUCHY_CB_NAME"
	interface_priority = 97
	attacker_wargoal_percentage = 0.8
	max_defender_score_from_occupation = 150
	max_attacker_score_from_occupation = 150

	ai_score_mult = { value = 1 }
}

			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:defender = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc_defender
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:attacker = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc_attacker
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc
		}
	}
	on_defeat = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		add_legitimacy_attacker_defeat_effect = yes
		scope:attacker = {
			pay_short_term_gold_reparations_effect = { GOLD_VALUE = 10 }
		}
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			victory = no
			title = scope:target
		}
		add_truce_attacker_defeat_effect = yes
	}

	on_primary_attacker_death = inherit
	on_primary_defender_death = inherit
	transfer_behavior = transfer
	attacker_allies_inherit = yes
	defender_allies_inherit = yes

	war_name = "CK_UNITE_SOL_HEGEMONY_CB_WAR_NAME"
	war_name_base = "CK_UNITE_SOL_HEGEMONY_CB_WAR_NAME_BASE"
	cb_name = "CK_UNITE_SOL_HEGEMONY_CB_NAME"
	interface_priority = 97
	attacker_wargoal_percentage = 0.8
	max_defender_score_from_occupation = 150
	max_attacker_score_from_occupation = 150

	ai_score_mult = { value = 1 }
}
